On a monthly basis Collection (as needed) and validation of dataset. This is foreseen as a regular and constant activity through the course of the project.

Deliverable includes scripts, datasets and epidemiological data summary. Format to be agreed during monthly teleconferences.

The validation of the datasets will be performed in close collaboration with the countries/study sites and will be aimed to build capacity and foster a progressive improvement of data reported by the countries/study sites over the course of the framework contract. Communication between the contractor and the countries/sites to validate the data will take place using principles agreed between the contractor and ECDC and periodically revisited. Production of regular laboratory results summary table to ECDC specifying the number of laboratory specimens processed and tested and the proportion of positive samples by study site, stratified by key variables. This deliverable includes all costs of sample processing, transport, laboratory data management and the diagnostic assay and refers to cost of performing the molecular diagnostic (i.e. RT-PCR) and serology, including standardization. The format of # Vaccine Effectiveness, Burden and Impact Studies (VEBIS) of COVID-19 and Influenza – Tender Specifications ECDC/2021/12924
